_meta.purpose: Product capability definition for Glider (public). Named browser-fu powers + primitives. Scoreboard = tests/contract.json.
_meta.regen_rule: Append-only for capabilities + walls_smashed. On change, bump version + add changelog entry.

tiers.T3_primitives: Raw browser-fu bricks. Discovered once, immutable. src_refs point to background.js:line.
tiers.T2_capabilities: Composed powers (recipes over primitives). Named + referenceable.
tiers.T1_cli_verbs: First-class glider --help handles. Promoted from T2 via /cliify-gap.
tiers.promotion_pipeline: T3 discovered → T2 named → T1 promoted (via cli_gaps[] → cliify)

changelog.summary: v0.3.21 ship: plugin_socket primitive, cookies+frozen public verbs, msal migrated to local plugin (ship_scope model)
DOM-scorch: full agnostic browser-fu primitive+capability sweep. 6 new T3 primitives, 40 T2 capabilities, 16 ordered T1 promotion gaps across 5 ship waves (0.3.22-0.3.26).

corsFetch.one_line: Fetch any URL from the extension's service-worker context, with HttpOnly cookies auto-attached via chrome.cookies.getAll — bypasses (a) CORS, (b) HttpOnly-cookie invisibility, (c) tab-freeze macrotask throttling.

invoke.http: POST http://localhost:19988/extension  body: {method:'corsFetch', params:{url, options:{method, headers, body}}}

known_bugs: (fixed in v0.3.20) CLI cmdCorsFetch crashed on empty/non-JSON responses
(fixed in v0.3.20) hardcoded Accept broke Yammer-family 406-strict endpoints
gotchas: Accept header sensitive: Yammer/engage rejects 'application/json' with 406; use 'application/json, text/plain, */*'. Purview accepts either.
Extension is not perfectly serialized — high concurrency causes some responses to return {error:'...'} transiently. Add retry+backoff (3x, 0.4/0.8/1.2s).
corsFetch.cli_handle_notes: v0.3.20+ handles empty-body responses + 2-shot Accept fallback

chrome_debugger_cdp.one_line: Full CDP method surface via chrome.debugger, forwarded to any attached tab. Runtime.evaluate + Page.reload + Input.dispatchMouseEvent all work. Network cookies + Emulation.setPageVisibilityOverride do NOT (MV3-gated).

invoke.http: POST http://localhost:19988/cdp  body: {method:'Runtime.evaluate', sessionId:'session-N', params:{expression, returnByValue}}

does_not_work: Network.getCookies / Network.getAllCookies / Storage.getCookies — MV3-gated to 0 cookies always
Fetch.enable request interception — no event stream from relay to CLI
Target.activateTarget / Page.bringToFront — succeed but tab visibility stays 'hidden' when Edge is minimized
gotchas: Hidden-tab macrotask freeze applies to any Runtime.evaluate involving setTimeout/fetch/image.onload/XHR/worker. Microtasks (Promise.then, queueMicrotask) still fire.

runtime_evaluate_sync_reads.one_line: Synchronous reads of document.cookie (non-HttpOnly), localStorage, sessionStorage from any attached tab — works even on frozen tabs.
gotchas: Async operations (fetch/setTimeout) will NOT complete on hidden/minimized tabs even though the evaluate call returns.

extension_ws_bridge.one_line: WebSocket bridge at ws://localhost:19988/extension routes arbitrary extension-side handlers exposed in background.js.

plugin_socket.one_line: Verb-agnostic loader: local ~/.glider/plugins/*.plugin.{json,js,cjs} extend the CLI at runtime with new verbs. Public npm binary carries zero verb branding; the operator hydrates their own tentacles locally.

invoke.js_shape: module.exports = {verb, aliases?, help[], async run(argv, ctx)}
invoke.json_shape: {verb, aliases?, help[], primitive:'eval'|'extension', recipe|method, args?, output?}

gotchas: Plugins can SHADOW builtin verbs — load order = local overrides core. Feature or footgun; document per-plugin.
ctx.cdp.eval requires ensureConnected() first — plugin is responsible.

dom_action_layer.one_line: Composed DOM interaction primitive: click-by-text/attr/nth, wait-until-selector-matches, read-with-attr. Kills the "every tribal lib hand-rolls one-line eval JS" tax.
dom_action_layer.discovered_from: digest of chat 6a92f73b — teams-lib.sh 7 wrappers, all thin `glider eval` shims

verbs.click: --text S | --contains S | --regex R | --nth N | --role R | --inside S | --wait MS | --scroll-into-view | --double | --right | --hold MS | --modifier ctrl|shift|alt|meta
verbs.wait: --selector S | --text T | --gone S | --matches JS | --stable MS | --network-idle | --url-matches R | --url-changes-from URL | --timeout MS | --poll MS

keyboard_input_layer.one_line: Raw CDP Input.dispatchKeyEvent — send individual keys, chords (Ctrl+Enter), sequences (ArrowDown x5), Unicode text, without the setValue/dispatchEvent hack that fails on rich editors.

implementation_plan.verb: key <chord|sequence>  e.g. `glider key Ctrl+Enter`, `glider key ArrowDown x5`, `glider key "Escape"`

pointer_input_layer.one_line: Raw CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent — coord clicks, right-click, double-click, hover (mousemove), drag (mousedown→move→up).

frame_traversal.one_line: Scope any DOM op into a specific iframe or open shadow root. Kills the "iframe SPA" wall (office apps, Yammer, embedded editors) and shadow-DOM webcomponents.

emulation_layer.one_line: CDP Emulation.* — timezone, geolocation, viewport, offline, user-agent, prefers-color-scheme, disable-service-worker.

implementation_plan.verb: emulate <what> <value>  e.g. `glider emulate tz Asia/Tokyo`, `glider emulate viewport 375x667`, `glider emulate offline true`

network_intercept.one_line: HAR capture (start/stop/dump), request replay, response mocking, download interception via CDP Network + Fetch domains.
network_intercept.partial_note: CLI surface + CDP domain enable live; bg event-stream (Network.requestWillBeSent, Fetch.requestPaused) deferred to 0.4.1

content_context_switch.one_line: Runtime.evaluate targeting isolated worlds, service workers, and worker threads — bypasses pages that null out `window.__proto__`, CSP-block eval, or hide state in a SW.

tab_thaw.one_line: Un-throttle a macrotask-frozen (hidden/minimized) tab IN PLACE -- resumes setTimeout/fetch/XHR/workers + in-page token refresh without restoring the OS window.
gotchas: Page.bringToFront / Target.activateTarget / window focus do NOT un-hide a minimized window -- they are NOT substitutes.
idempotent; safe to call --all across every attached tab.
sync Runtime.evaluate reads already work on frozen tabs (runtime_evaluate_sync_reads); thaw is only needed when you need ASYNC or in-page refresh to run.

iframe_target_pin.purpose: eval JS inside a cross-origin iframe using CDP session pinning
iframe_target_pin.discovery_cmd: glider targets | grep gallerycdn.vsassets.io  (or extension host)
iframe_target_pin.trigger: page must instantiate the iframe (e.g. click extension tab) before target appears

chromium_profile_preferences.one_line: Atomically edit a Chromium profile Preferences JSON while the browser is quit, then reopen and verify retained state.

invoke.cli: quit browser; jq update profile Preferences; reopen; jq verify

claude_files_range_size.description: API probe only. CRX not wired (failures.json F-002/F-010). GET https://claude.ai/api/organizations/{ORG}/files/{FILE_UUID}/contents with header Range: bytes=0-0. Expect 206, Content-Range bytes 0-0/{N}, 1-byte body. N is exact original size for files-api and sandbox/wiggle uuids.

GET /api/organizations/{ORG}/cowork/scheduled_tasks and /{trig_id}; also /v1/code/triggers?tags=cowork-scheduled with anthropic-beta ccr-triggers-2026-01-30; runs via /v1/code/sessions?only_trigger_sessions=true

get_httponly_cookies.primitive: corsFetch (implicit — cookies auto-attached to outbound requests) OR direct chrome.cookies.getAll from an extension patch

detect_frozen_tab.one_line: Determine whether a tab is under Chrome's hidden-tab macrotask throttling.
detect_frozen_tab.recipe: eval `document.visibilityState + '|' + document.hidden`  →  'hidden|true' means macrotasks (setTimeout, fetch, XHR, workers) will not fire.

run_cdp_on_backgrounded_tab.one_line: Runtime.evaluate for SYNC JS still works on hidden tabs. Anything async (fetch, setTimeout, promise chain that awaits network) will hang.
run_cdp_on_backgrounded_tab.workaround: Use corsFetch instead — runs in the service worker, not the tab.

double_click.one_line: Two rapid clicks within Chrome dblclick threshold.

wait_until_selector_matches_v.one_line: Poll until querySelector(sel) matches (present; text when supplied).

wait_until_gone.one_line: Poll until querySelector(sel) returns null (element removed).

wait_until_stable.one_line: Element bounding-rect unchanged for N ms (animations settled).

wait_network_idle.one_line: No in-flight requests for N ms via Network.requestWillBeSent counter.

wait_url_matches.one_line: Poll until location.href matches regex — proves nav completed.

read_element_prop.one_line: JS property (el.value, el.checked, el.dataset.X) on first match.

element_visible.one_line: Boolean: getBoundingClientRect area > 0 AND not display:none/visibility:hidden.

iframe_scope_eval.one_line: Run any DOM op scoped to a specific iframe (by CSS sel or index).

shadow_root_scope_eval.one_line: Pierce open shadow roots to reach webcomponent-internal DOM.

list_frames.one_line: Full frame tree with URL + frameId.

a11y_snapshot.one_line: Accessibility.getFullAXTree — semantic snapshot for LLM-agent consumption.

capture_har.one_line: Record all Network events into HAR 1.2 format.

replay_request.one_line: Re-issue a captured HAR entry (fetch from bg with same headers/cookies).

tenant_indexed_community_discovery.one_line: Search tenant-indexed pages and documents for internal community, FAQ, and support destinations through the authenticated SharePoint search plane.
tenant_indexed_community_discovery.primitive: Uses the existing corsFetch primitive through tenant-spray.py to query the tenant SharePoint index.
tenant_indexed_community_discovery.recipe: Run tenant-spray.py with --connectors and pages,docs verticals using product, enrollment, and community/support terms; verify returned pages by retrieving their authored canvas content.

halt_background_tab_freeze.one_line: Halt a hidden/background tab's task queues (timers/rAF/fetch/JS alloc) in place to contain a runaway/leaking bg tab, without killing the renderer or losing DOM state.
halt_background_tab_freeze.recipe: Page.setWebLifecycleState{state:'frozen'} via the CRX CDP bridge on a hidden target (skip visible); reverse of thaw's {state:'active'}. Auto-resumes on focus. CONTAINMENT not reclaim: stops ongoing allocation/CPU; does NOT free existing heap (V8 GC self-heals dead heap; discard frees live DOM/images).

cookie_jar_hydrate.one_line: Write $GLIDER/cookies/<host> jar into a Chromium cookie store (default or Incognito via storeId).

claude_preflight_disk_bytes.description: API probe only. CRX not wired (failures.json F-002). Estimate Claude chat archive disk bytes before sidecar body download: sum chat JSON raw.length + inline + files[].size_bytes; for each file_uuid missing size, GET /files/{uuid}/contents with Range bytes=0-0 and parse Content-Range total (1-byte body). Do not HEAD (405). Do not Range-probe wiggle/download-file (ignores Range, full body).

claude_scheduled_capture.description: API probe only. CRX not wired (failures.json F-001). Name is aspirational. Enumerate and fetch Claude Scheduled (Cowork) tasks + run sessions; not covered by chat_conversations capture.

flywheel_rules: Before opening any new potemkin scorch: read capabilities.json in this package first.
If a wall matches an entry in walls_smashed, apply the solved_by primitive directly — no rediscovery.
If wall is new: solve it, then APPEND to walls_smashed with root_cause + solved_by + src_refs + checkpoint.
If a primitive is discovered but absent from in `glider --help`, file an entry under 'cli_gaps' with the exact patch needed.

extension_gaps.issue: Verb returns count:0 tokens on modern MSAL v2 sites even when localStorage has 10+ msal.2 access tokens. Root cause: plugin reads localStorage keys but msal.2 values are {id,nonce,data} with data=encrypted-at-rest AES-GCM ciphertext. Plugin parses as if plaintext JWT (msal.1 format).
extension_gaps.evidence_probe: planner.cloud.microsoft session had msal.2 cache with tasks.readwrite scope bundle in key; glider msal --json returned {count:0, tokens:[]}
extension_gaps.impact: The 'shipped' fix (msal_extract_verb_proposed) is Potemkin against all modern MSFT SPAs. Silent failure — user doesn't know their token cache is being missed.
fix_paths: A: walk webpack module graph (window.webpackChunk_N_E or __webpack_require__.c) to find msal PublicClientApplication instance, invoke instance.acquireTokenSilent({account, scopes, forceRefresh:false}) which returns decrypted
B: expose bg-side Network.responseReceived listener that snaps Authorization headers off outgoing requests (simpler, works for ANY auth scheme not just MSAL)
